overview.en: Musk's decision-making framework is physics-based, emphasizing data-driven analysis, timeline compression, and rational risk assessment. He uses physical laws and quantitative analysis to guide every major choice. His decision-making style can be summarized as 'fact-based decisive action' — once data supports a direction, he advances execution with astonishing speed.
overview.zh: 马斯克的决策框架以物理学为基础，强调数据驱动、时间线压缩和理性风险评估。他用物理学定律和量化分析来指导每一个重大选择。他的决策风格可以概括为'基于事实的果断行动'——一旦数据支持某个方向，他会以惊人的速度推进执行。

principles.en: Physics-Based Decision Making — Use physical laws as the underlying logic for decisions. If a plan violates fundamental laws of physics, it is doomed to fail.
principles.zh: 基于物理学的决策 — 用物理学定律作为决策的底层逻辑。如果一个计划违反了物理学基本定律，那么它注定失败。

principles.en: Timeline Compression — Traditional time estimates are usually too conservative. Through parallel work, eliminating bottlenecks, and 24/7 shifts, timelines can be compressed to a fraction of traditional estimates.
principles.zh: 时间线压缩 — 传统的时间预估通常过于保守。通过并行工作、消除瓶颈和24/7轮班，可以将时间线压缩到传统估算的一小部分。

principles.en: Rational Risk Assessment — Evaluate risk with 'what's the worst that could happen?' thinking. If the worst outcome is company failure but not human extinction, it's worth trying.
principles.zh: 理性风险评估 — 用'最坏情况会怎样？'的思维方式评估风险。如果最坏的结果是公司倒闭但人类没有灭绝，那就值得尝试。

principles.en: 5-Year vs 10-Year Thinking Horizon — Maintain both short-term execution capability and long-term vision simultaneously. 5-year plans focus on milestones; 10-year vision focuses on civilization-level changes.
principles.zh: 5年与10年思维跨度 — 同时保持短期执行力和长期愿景。5年规划关注具体的技术里程碑和商业目标，10年愿景关注人类文明的根本性改变。

principles.en: Data-Driven Rapid Decisions — Make decisions immediately after collecting sufficient data. In most cases, 70% of the information is enough to make the right decision.
principles.zh: 数据驱动的快速决策 — 收集足够的数据后立即决策，不要等到拥有完美信息。在大多数情况下，70%的信息就足以做出正确决策。

principles.en: Binary Tree Decision Method — Decompose complex decisions into a series of binary choices. Each node only requires answering 'yes' or 'no,' greatly reducing cognitive load.
principles.zh: 二叉树决策法 — 将复杂决策分解为一系列二元选择。每个节点只需要回答'是'或'否'，大大降低了决策的认知负荷。

description.en: When NASA's SLS rocket costs overran to tens of billions, Musk decided to replace SLS with Starship. Based on physics analysis, fully reusable super-heavy rockets were technically feasible and costs could be reduced 1000x. Despite multiple failures, this ultimately achieved the largest successful rocket launch in human history.
description.zh: 当NASA的SLS火箭开发成本超支到数百亿美元时，马斯克做出了用星舰替代SLS的决策。他基于物理学分析认为，完全可重复使用的超重型火箭在技术上可行，且成本可以降低1000倍。虽然经历了多次失败，但最终实现了人类历史上最大的火箭成功发射。

description.en: When most automakers chose L4 autonomous driving routes similar to Waymo, Musk decided on an incremental approach based on data: vision + neural networks better aligned with first principles because humans drive with vision. This enabled Tesla to accumulate billions of miles of driving data.
description.zh: 当大多数汽车公司选择与Waymo类似的L4级自动驾驶路线时，马斯克基于数据做出了不同的决策：采用渐进式方法。他认为视觉+神经网络比激光雷达方案更符合第一性原理，因为人类就是用视觉驾驶的。这个决策使Tesla积累了数十亿英里的驾驶数据。

description.en: Traditional auto factory construction takes 3-4 years. Musk demanded Gigafactory be built and operational within 2 years. Through 24/7 construction and parallel building, Nevada Gigafactory began production in under 2 years. Shanghai Gigafactory went from groundbreaking to production in under a year.
description.zh: 传统汽车工厂的建设需要3-4年。马斯克要求Gigafactory在2年内建成投产。通过24/7施工、并行建设，Nevada Gigafactory在不到2年内开始生产。上海Gigafactory更是创造了从动工到投产不到一年的记录。

description.en: In 2022, Musk decided to acquire Twitter for $44 billion in extremely short time. While controversial, this reflected his style: act quickly based on long-term vision (building the 'everything app'), undisturbed by short-term market noise. He later renamed Twitter to X and cut staff drastically.
description.zh: 2022年，马斯克在极短时间内决定以440亿美元收购Twitter。虽然这个决策备受争议，但它体现了马斯克的决策风格：基于长期愿景快速行动，不被短期市场噪音干扰。他后来将Twitter改名为X，并大幅裁减员工。

description.en: In 2023, Musk quickly founded xAI with the goal of 'understanding the true nature of the universe.' Based on his assessment that OpenAI had deviated from its open-source mission, Grok was developed in a short time and integrated into the X platform, demonstrating astonishing speed from decision to execution.
description.zh: 2023年，马斯克快速决策成立xAI，目标是'理解宇宙的真实本质'。基于对AI领域竞争格局的判断，Grok在短时间内完成开发并集成到X平台，展现了马斯克从决策到执行的惊人速度。

quotes.en: Physics is the law. Everything else is a recommendation.
quotes.zh: 物理学就是法律。其他一切都是建议。

quotes.en: I think the most important thing is to have a clear and compelling mission. If you have that, then the decisions become much easier.
quotes.zh: 我认为最重要的是拥有一个清晰而引人注目的使命。如果你有这个，那么决策就会变得容易得多。

quotes.en: When I make a decision, I try to think about it from a physics standpoint. What are the constraints? What does physics allow?
quotes.zh: 当我做决策时，我尝试从物理学的角度来思考。约束条件是什么？物理学允许什么？

quotes.en: You should take the approach that you're wrong. Your goal is to be less wrong.
quotes.zh: 你应该采取这样的态度：你是错的。你的目标是变得更不犯错。

quotes.en: I don't believe in process. In fact, when I interview a potential employee and they say 'it's all about the process,' I see that as a bad sign.
quotes.zh: 我不相信流程。事实上，当我面试一个潜在员工而他们说'一切都在于流程'时，我认为这是一个坏兆头。

quotes.en: The thing is, if you're not failing, you're not trying hard enough. And if you're not trying hard enough, you're not going to succeed.
quotes.zh: 问题是，如果你没有失败，说明你尝试得不够努力。如果你尝试得不够努力，你就不会成功。

quotes.en: I think it's very important to have a feedback loop, where you're constantly thinking about what you've done and how you could be doing it better.
quotes.zh: 我认为拥有一个反馈循环非常重要，你要不断思考你做了什么以及如何做得更好。

quotes.en: My biggest mistake is probably weighing too much on someone's talent and not someone's personality. I think it matters whether someone has a good heart.
quotes.zh: 我最大的错误可能是过于看重某人的才华而忽视了他的性格。我认为一个人是否有一颗善良的心很重要。

quotes.en: Don't tell me about the problems. Tell me about the solutions.
quotes.zh: 不要告诉我问题是什么。告诉我解决方案是什么。

quotes.en: I always have optimism, but I'm realistic. It was never about the odds. It was always about the belief.
quotes.zh: 我总是乐观的，但我也是现实的。这从来不是关于概率的问题。这始终是关于信念的问题。

en: Physics constraint check: verify plan doesn't violate physical laws or logical constraints before any decision
Worst-case analysis: evaluate worst outcome of each option; if acceptable, proceed boldly
Timeline challenge: question any time estimate, look for acceleration methods; default assumption is timelines can be compressed
Data collection threshold: set threshold (e.g., 70% information), decide immediately upon reaching it, avoid analysis paralysis
Binary decomposition: break complex decisions into binary choices, gradually narrow decision space
Feedback loop establishment: immediately establish feedback after decision execution, quickly validate and adjust
zh: 物理约束检查：在做任何决策前，首先检查方案是否违反基本物理定律或逻辑约束
最坏情况分析：评估每个选项的最坏结果。如果最坏结果是可接受的，就大胆推进
时间线挑战：对任何时间预估提出质疑，寻找加速执行的方法
数据收集阈值：设定数据收集的阈值（如70%信息量），达到后立即决策
二元分解：将复杂决策分解为一系列二元选择，逐步缩小决策空间
反馈循环建立：决策执行后立即建立反馈机制，快速验证决策的正确性并调整方向
